sequence.title: Hollow Purple
sequence.objective: First major cinematic peak: Hollow Purple with full identity (two separate techniques, a visible charge, fusion, a clean trajectory, a wall of imaginary mass). The lit city constrains Gojo's line; Thragg evades the core through raw speed and counters, but pays with his left forearm, his left flank and his left ear.
sequence.logic: Seq 4 ended with Gojo EAST of Thragg: the point-blank Red threw both of them into open sky. Seq 5 therefore opens with the screen direction reversed, and Thragg is charging east. His renewed attack goes for the head, the lesson of 'So. It is a choice': damage must be total (S5-01). The Six Eyes tell Gojo where Thragg is, not what he intends (R5). Gojo refuses to let Infinity answer the question Thragg is asking and leaves the plane on a Blue self-pull. The pause belongs to Thragg. He drifts, unhurried, until the lit city across the river sits exactly behind him in Gojo's eyeline (S5-02; T1-19 hostage logic). The rack focus is Gojo's read: any flat shot that misses goes into those windows. So Gojo spends almost three seconds flying up and over Thragg to the west (S5-03). That puts him back between Thragg and the lights, as in Seq 1, and restores the film's screen direction (Gojo left, Thragg right). His line now slopes down into the empty eastern district. Thragg does not chase. He banks breath and a fact: he protects the lights (S5-04), the leverage Thragg uses in Seq 6. Then the score falls away and Purple is built in three readable stages: two separate techniques with opposite behaviour (S5-05, S5-06); their effect on the world, a local darkening, bent light and trembling debris (S5-07); and the cost, in Gojo's still face and reddening eyes (S5-08). Purple takes time to charge (G1-29), and Thragg sees it: for the first time the man has needed TIME (S5-09). He launches straight down the firing line. That line is the fastest and also the most predictable, so Gojo completes the fusion and releases on it at once (S5-10). The breath Thragg banked during the relocation is what lets him throw the last-instant corkscrew. The core misses; the outer shell takes his trailing left forearm at mid-forearm, and the displacement wake flays his left flank and tears off his left ear (R7: a CREATIVE margin, with no claim about the core against Viltrumite flesh). Still spinning, he drives a counter into Gojo's ribs. It stalls in Infinity until the wake rips him away (S5-11). Purple carries on along a line chosen to cost nothing: four empty towers and a street, while everything west of Gojo stays untouched (S5-12). The aftermath sets up the next two sequences. Thragg is maimed for good, because nothing regrows (T1-47). He is no longer amused and resolves never to give Gojo time again (S5-13), which becomes Seq 6's assault. Gojo's biggest technique has missed; anything he aims, this body can dodge, so his next finish must be one Thragg cannot slip. With his eyes bloodshot, he presses two fingers to his temple and refreshes his brain with RCT (S5-14), planting the mechanic Seq 7 depends on. Neither fighter is untouched. Everything plays in real time; there is no slow motion (that is reserved for Seq 7).
sequence.music_cue: S5-01: the Seq 4 toms snap back for one bar under the renewed charge (RETURN f0) and are cut dead on the miss. S5-02 to S5-04: a suspended low string pedal on D with no percussion; Thragg's descending minor third and Gojo's rising fifth are exchanged softly. S5-05 f4: DROP_OUT, a total drop to a low sub rumble as Gojo raises his hands. Layers enter through the charge: a restrained choir (SWELL S5-06 f20), then low brass (SWELL S5-07 f6), then a high string tremolo (S5-08). Thragg's minor-third STINGER lands on his recognition (S5-09 f8) and the cluster crescendos through his anticipation. The full orchestra crests with a HIT on the release frame (S5-10 f4) and sustains under the stall, ducked so the infinity_stop ring reads (S5-11 f5), then decays under the destruction (S5-12). Sustained strings carry the aftermath (S5-13, S5-14) and thin out toward Seq 6.
sequence.state_out: Gojo: hovering about 200 m up, west of the Purple channel, x=-20, y=200; facing east; eyes open (blindfold at his neck, hair loose); injuries jacket_torn_shoulder, bloodshot_eyes; hands lowered, breathing deliberately, focus restored by an RCT refresh at the temple. Thragg: hovering and listing east of the channel, x=+70, y=140; facing west; cape torn; injuries mouth_blood, torn_suit, cracked_ribs, chest_burn, forearm_lost, flank_flayed, ear_torn; no longer amused, resolved to end it before another Purple can form. Env: Purple channel through four eastern towers plus a trench down the street; smoke columns; dust plume drifting west (env flags: landing_crater, mast_sheared, east_smash, tower_gutted, clouds_torn, purple_scar, smoke).

Thragg is already in motion out of Seq 4's last frame, at x=+95, y=150 on f0, 20 m south of the plane in front of the tower's south-east corner, closing east and curving back onto the plane by f4. f2: a Blue point snaps open at x=+121, y=184. f4-16: Gojo is pulled straight up from y=150 to y=182, decelerating into the point, which winks out on arrival. f6: Thragg's right cross passes through x=+120, y=151.7, head height of Gojo's vacated position. f6-12: momentum carries Thragg to x=+125. f12-17: he plants on the air and settles at x=+124, y=153, facing up. shots.action: f0-5: Thragg is mid-charge out of Seq 4: shredded cape remnant streaming, right fist cocked at his ear, hips loading a full-body cross at Gojo's head (5 frames of anticipation: hip turn, shoulder drop). f1: Gojo's right hand flicks two fingers upward; his bare eyes catch Thragg's shoulders bunching late. f2: a small Blue point snaps open 32 m above him: a white-blue core, a dark lensing ring, a thin bright rim. f3: drifting dust and grit around Gojo stream up into it first. f4: Gojo is yanked straight up, his body tilting back, feet trailing together. f6: CONTACT WITH NOTHING. The cross rips through the empty air where Gojo's head was, and a cone of displaced air peels off the knuckles. f6-12: Thragg's mass carries him on beneath Gojo. f12-17: he plants on the air: his body rotates upward first, then the trajectory stops, and a ring of vapour puffs off him. f16: Gojo arrives at the point, which winks out. f17-40: hold. Gojo hangs 30 m above, looking down; no smile. Below, Thragg clamps his right hand to his cracked right ribs, his chest heaving.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg's renewed charge at the head. Gojo yanks himself straight up on a Blue point; the cross hits air.
shots.prompt_core: Wide side-on shot in open sky at dusk, 150 metres above a ruined city. A massive warrior in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit, a shredded crimson cape remnant streaming, drives a full-body right cross through empty air at head height; a cone of displaced air peels off the missed fist. Thirty metres above him, a tall white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform, a blindfold hanging at his neck, is yanked straight upward toward a small point of white-blue light ringed by a dark lens of bent space. Fine dust and grit streak up into it in straight lines. Below: a shattered skyline, a gutted unfinished tower with a fallen crane, smoke columns, the storm deck torn open overhead. Warm sunset rim light from screen-left.

tactical.intent: Thragg: hit the head while Gojo is still re-setting after the collarbone heal. If the barrier is a choice, find out whether it came back with the bone. Damage must be total, so the head.
tactical.read: Gojo: the Six Eyes give him where Thragg is, not what he intends (R5); his bare eyes catch the shoulders bunch late. Rather than let Infinity answer the question Thragg is asking, he leaves the plane.
tactical.outcome: The cross rakes empty air. Thragg overshoots and has to plant on the air beneath Gojo, and the brake punishes his cracked ribs.
tactical.learned: Thragg: Gojo won't let him test the barrier on Thragg's terms, and chasing in open sky gets nothing. Gojo: close range is now Thragg's game; get distance and build something.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 1s for the cross and the plant: body rotates first, trajectory follows (the VFX bible's 'plant on the air'). Gojo on 1s for the yank (f4-10), easing to 2s as he decelerates. No flailing: legs trail together, hands stay loose. The Blue self-pull uses the established Blue grammar at small scale: light dust first, nothing heavy. This is a miss, so there is no contact frame and no impact star. Thragg's guarded breath on 2s from f20: short in, slow out, the right hand clamped to the right ribs.

shots.action: f0-14: Gojo turns his head and shoulders to keep Thragg in front of him as Thragg slides out from beneath. f6-44: Thragg drifts west and up through the floating debris, unhurried: right hand pressed to his cracked right ribs, chest heaving, blood at the split lip, the cape remnant stirring. His eyes never leave Gojo. f30-36: he glances once over his own shoulder at the glow behind him. f36-44: one last small correction, rising 2 m, until his silhouette sits exactly on the band of lit towers across the river. He stops. f40-50: Gojo's read. The focus racks off Thragg to the lit city: thousands of warm windows, sharp, with Thragg a soft dark shape in front of them. The edge of Gojo's cheek shifts as his eyes flick from the man to the lights. f52-60: the focus racks back to Thragg, waiting, breathing. Any flat shot that misses him goes into those windows.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg drifts until the lit city across the river sits right behind him. A missed shot would land there.
shots.prompt_core: Long-lens over-the-shoulder shot in open sky at dusk. A tall white-haired man's shoulder and high black collar fill the soft right edge of frame. Forty metres beyond him, level with him, a massive warrior in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit hovers among floating concrete chips and glass, one hand pressed to bruised ribs, chest heaving, blood at the corner of his mouth, a shredded crimson cape remnant stirring. Directly behind the warrior, three kilometres away across a river, a lit, living city glows under the low sunset: thousands of warm windows on the horizon, aligned exactly with his silhouette. Focus racks from the warrior to the glowing city and back. Storm-dark sky above; warm rim light from screen-left.

tactical.intent: Thragg: turn the people across the river into a shield. With the lights behind him, every flat shot Gojo takes risks them (hostage logic).
tactical.read: Gojo: it is deliberate. Thragg checked the alignment over his shoulder.
tactical.outcome: Gojo will not fire on this line. The fight pauses, and Thragg gets seconds to breathe.
tactical.learned: Gojo: Thragg understands what Gojo cares about and will use it.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 2s: a slow drift with no flight pose, upright and controlled, the stillness of a veteran. His breath cycles every 20 frames, the guarded breathing of cracked ribs (short in, slow out). The over-the-shoulder glance at f30-36 is a single economical head turn. The Gojo foreground is on 2s: a held silhouette apart from the head turn (f0-14) and the eye flick (f40-50), which shows only as a shift in the cheek and lashes. The rack focus is the read; do not add a reaction face.

shots.action: f0-8: Gojo rises a few metres, unhurried, hands at his sides. f8-48: he flies a clean, effortless arc up and over Thragg toward the west: no contrail, no boom, a small dark figure crossing the torn storm deck. Thragg rotates to keep facing him and does not chase. f48-64: Gojo settles 200 m above the intersection, west of and above Thragg, and turns to face east. The geometry now reads at a glance. Gojo is high on the left, between Thragg and the lit city; Thragg is lower right; below and beyond Thragg lies the empty, dark eastern district. Any line from Gojo through Thragg now runs downward into empty ruins. It has cost him nearly three seconds.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo flies up and over him to the west, setting a downward line into the empty east. It costs time.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme wide shot of a vast evacuated city at storm-dark dusk, seen from 200 metres up. At the far left, across a river, a lit, living city glows under the sunset. Right of centre stands a gutted unfinished skyscraper with a fallen crane; smoke columns rise from wrecked towers, and the storm deck overhead is torn open. A tiny dark figure with white hair flies a smooth rising arc from right to left over a second, broader figure in white and crimson hovering in place, and settles high above the intersection on the left, between the warrior and the lit city. The hovering warrior has turned to follow him. Below and beyond the warrior lies the dark, empty eastern district. No contrails; drifting debris specks.

tactical.intent: Gojo: protect the city. Put himself between Thragg and the lights and set a firing line that slopes down into the empty eastern district.
tactical.read: Thragg watches without chasing and reads the reason for the move.
tactical.outcome: Gojo gets a safe line. Thragg gains time, and his breathing steadies.
tactical.learned: Thragg: he protects the lights (the leverage for Seq 6's break west).

shots.animation_notes: Gojo on 2s: an effortless glide with only a slight forward lean. His flight never shows strain or thrust (no vapour, no boom), the opposite of every Viltrumite move. Thragg on 2s: rotation only, no translation. Keep both figures readable as silhouettes against the cloud gap; Gojo's white hair catches the rim light.

shots.prompt_core: Close-up, three-quarter front, of a massive, severe man with close-cropped black hair and a thick black mustache, hovering in a dusk sky. A split lip with a line of blood; the white-and-crimson uniform torn open at the right shoulder and chest, a scorched burn below. His cold dark eyes look up and to the left, dip toward a warm distant glow, and return; tiny points of city light reflect in them. He breathes slowly through the nose, one hand pressed to bruised ribs at the bottom of frame. The background is soft: dark storm sky, a smoke column, drifting specks of debris. Warm rim light from screen-left on his cheekbone and mustache.

tactical.intent: Thragg: understand why the man spent time moving instead of attacking.
tactical.read: The new position puts Gojo between him and the lights, and the shot line now runs into empty ruins.
tactical.outcome: He takes the seconds and banks the breath.
tactical.learned: He protects the lights: leverage, used in Seq 6's break for the city.

shots.action: f0-4: stillness. f4: the music falls away. f4-16: Gojo raises both hands from his sides to chest height, palms facing, elbows soft, no flourish. f16: Blue ignites at the left palm: a white-blue core, a dark lensing ring, a thin bright edge. f16-34: light things arrive first. Dust streams in along straight lines, then glints of glass, and at f30 a fist-sized concrete chip starts sliding toward it, slower. f30: Red ignites at the right fingertips as a tight crimson point that jitters (f30-35), then swells into an unstable fist-sized orb (f36-44) throwing violent repulsion. The same drifting dust that streams toward Blue is flung away from Red in hard pulses, and his right hand trembles with the recoil. f44-56: both hold, each doing the opposite thing. Gojo's face stays perfectly level.
shots.animatic_caption: Silence. Gojo raises both hands: Blue pulls at the left, Red jitters and repels at the right.
shots.prompt_core: Low-angle medium shot in a storm-dark dusk sky. A tall man with loose white hair, a blindfold hanging at his neck and a black high-collared uniform torn and bloodstained at the left shoulder, hovers with both hands raised to chest height, palms facing. At his left palm, a small white-blue sphere ringed by dark, bent space draws dust and glass toward it in straight streaks. At his right fingertips, a crimson orb jitters and pulses, blasting the same dust outward in hard rings. His vivid blue eyes are level and calm. Behind him, the torn storm deck and a gap of warm light. Rim light from screen-left.

tactical.outcome: Two separate techniques are running at once. It is visible, and it takes time.
tactical.learned: Both know this one is slow (Thragg acts on it in S5-09).

No aura around Gojo's body: the light lives in the hands.

shots.action: f0-20: the two techniques sit side by side, unmistakably different. Blue drags a thread of dust and glass into its core; Red shoves the nearest part of that same thread back out in jittering pulses, so the stream between them stalls and shreds. f20-40: the hands begin to close, and the space between the orbs bends: the background folds toward Blue and bulges away from Red. f28: the first tension arc crackles between them, a thin violet-white filament, followed by more, faster (f34, f38, f41, f43, f45). f40-60: the orbs are a hand-width apart, both straining. Small debris caught between them vibrates in place. Gojo's fingers are perfectly steady.
shots.animatic_caption: Two opposite forces in one pair of hands. They close. Violet arcs crackle in the gap.
shots.prompt_core: Tight insert of two hands at dusk, palms facing, slowly closing. At the upper-left hand, a white-blue sphere with a black ring of bent space draws streaks of dust and glass inward along straight lines. At the lower-right hand, an unstable crimson orb jitters and pushes the same particles outward in pulsing rings. The stream of dust between them stalls and shreds. Thin violet-white electrical arcs crackle across the shrinking gap, tiny concrete chips vibrate in place between the orbs, and the background warps toward the blue and bulges away from the red. A black uniform cuff and chin soft behind. Deep blue and crimson light, violet where they meet.
shots.animation_notes: Effects on 1s, hands on 2s. The arcs come faster and faster, from every 6 frames to every 2. Never let the two orbs merge in this shot: the fusion is S5-10. Keep the separate behaviours legible: Blue is smooth and inward, Red is jagged and outward.

shots.prompt_core: A dynamic shot sweeping from a white-haired man's face along his outstretched arms as a huge sphere of violet light surges away from his hands: a bright hot shell, a darker hollow core with slow swirls, a corona that bends the dusk sky. A massive warrior in white and crimson, flying head-first straight at it, twists into a corkscrew roll under its rim. His trailing left forearm is torn away at the shell in a violet-white flash and the stump seared black, while a violet-black wake streaming off the sphere strips his left flank raw and rips away his left ear in a ribbon of blood mist. Floating debris in the sphere's path vanishes. Storm-dark sky, torn clouds.

tactical.outcome: The core misses. The shell takes his left forearm at mid-forearm; the wake flays his left flank and tears off his left ear. The beat Gojo spent relocating is the beat Thragg used to breathe and get set, and it is why the roll was there.
tactical.learned: Gojo: anything I aim, this body can dodge (Seq 6: he goes for the heart by hand). Thragg: the shell alone can take a limb; never be on its line again.

Do not linger on gore: the stump reads in S5-11 and S5-13. The camera move is fast but readable: origin (face, hands), then path (riding the sphere), then the miss in the middle distance.

shots.action: f0-20: Gojo lowers his hands slowly to his sides. f20-50: he breathes deliberately, a slow count in and a slow count out, twice. The whites of his eyes are laced with red, and a faint tremor in the fingers of his right hand stills. His jacket is torn and bloodstained at the left shoulder. f50-56: he lifts two fingers of his right hand and presses them to his right temple. f56-72: a faint warm-white shimmer glows under the skin at the temple for 16 frames as he runs Reverse Cursed Technique through his own brain, refreshing it. f72-84: his eyes clear. The glaze of strain leaves his gaze and the focus snaps back, though the red veins remain. f84-100: he lowers the hand and looks down and to the right, at Thragg. No smile. Steady.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo lowers his hands, breathing deliberately. Two fingers to the temple: a faint RCT shimmer. Eyes clear.
shots.prompt_core: Medium close-up of a tall, pale man with loose snow-white hair hovering in a dusk sky, his black high-collared uniform torn and bloodstained at the left shoulder, a black blindfold hanging at his neck. He has just lowered his hands and breathes slowly and deliberately. The whites of his vivid blue eyes are laced with red veins. He presses two fingers to his right temple; a faint warm-white shimmer glows beneath the skin there for a moment, and his gaze sharpens into clear focus. He looks down and to the right, serious and unsmiling. Behind him, dust and smoke drift across a storm-dark sky with a tear of warm light.

tactical.intent: Gojo: clear the strain before the next exchange. The Six Eyes and Limitless cost the brain, and RCT keeps it fresh.
tactical.read: Thragg is alive, maimed, and has decided something.
tactical.outcome: His focus is restored but the bloodshot remains, and his biggest technique has been spent on a miss.
tactical.learned: Gojo: anything I aim, he can dodge, so the next finish must be one he cannot slip (Seq 6's domain).

shots.animation_notes: Gojo on 2s. The breath is the performance: chest and shoulders on a 24-frame-in, 24-frame-out cycle. RCT follows the VFX bible: a soft warm-white shimmer at the site for 12-20 frames (here 16), with no green and no sparkles. 'Eyes clear' is a change of focus (the pupils tighten, the lids relax a fraction), not a change of colour; the red veins stay for continuity. This plants RCT-on-the-brain for Seq 7.
vfx: bloodshot veins in the whites (continuity)
RCT: a faint warm-white shimmer under the skin at the right temple (f56-72)
dust and smoke drifting behind

music.note: Sustained strings only, thinning toward the end. Seq 6 opens on Thragg's assault, then silence at the hand sign.
